name: Item card
description: One item in a category: its photo on top, the price, name and description below, and the control for adding it, which overlaps the photo's bottom-right edge. The control slot holds the Add button, the quantity stepper or an Out of stock label.

price.description: The price of one item, such as "₹20".

image.description: The item's photo. Leave it out to show a plain tile.

children.description: The control: the Add button, the quantity stepper or an Out of stock badge. Show one at a time.
